business_summary: XP Inc. engages in the provision of financial products and services in Brazil. It operates XP Platform, an open product platform that provides clients to access investment products in the market comprising brokerage securities, fixed income securities, mutual, hedge, and private equity funds; derivatives and synthetic instruments; credit cards; loan operations/collateralized credit products; pension and social security funds, and life and travel insurance products; and other investment products comprising real estate funds, and equity and debt capital markets solutions, as well as wealth management services. The company offers brokerage and issuer services to institutional and corporate clients. It also manages mutual funds focused on stocks and macro strategies distributed to retail and to institutional clients; funds and managed portfolios for high-net-worth retail clients, and proprietary treasury funds; and passive mutual funds that track market indexes, and mutual and investment funds focused on fixed income, credit, real estate, infrastructure, and other alternative strategies. In addition, the company offers securities brokerage services for institutional and retail investors; interdealer brokerage services for institutional traders; and commercial and investment banking products, such as loan operations and transactions in the foreign exchange markets and deposits, as well as develops and sells financial education courses and events online and in person to retail clients. It offers its sell products and services through its omni-channel distribution network and online portals. XP Inc. was founded in 2001 and is based in George Town, the Cayman Islands.
business_summary_ko: XP Inc.는 브라질에서 금융 상품 및 서비스 제공에 종사하고 있습니다. 고객이 중개 증권, 고정 수입 증권, 뮤추얼, 헤지 및 사모 펀드로 구성된 시장에서 투자 상품에 액세스할 수 있도록 제공하는 개방형 상품 플랫폼인 XP 플랫폼을 운영합니다. 파생상품 및 합성상품; 신용카드; 대출 운영/담보 신용 상품; 연금 및 사회보장기금, 생명보험 및 여행보험 상품; 부동산 펀드, 주식 및 부채 자본 시장 솔루션, 자산 관리 서비스로 구성된 기타 투자 상품입니다. 이 회사는 기관 및 기업 고객에게 중개 및 발행자 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 소매 및 기관 고객에게 배포되는 주식 및 거시 전략에 초점을 맞춘 뮤추얼 펀드를 관리합니다. 고액 소매 고객을 위한 펀드 및 관리 포트폴리오와 독점 재무 펀드; 시장 지수를 추적하는 패시브 뮤추얼 펀드와 채권, 신용, 부동산, 인프라 및 기타 대안 전략에 초점을 맞춘 뮤추얼 및 투자 펀드 등이 있습니다. 또한, 회사는 기관 및 개인 투자자를 위한 증권 중개 서비스를 제공합니다.
